notes.title: Patch 3.1.6 - Fix For Error Displaying Incorrect Math Expression
notes.content: Hotfix for error where text displayed for math expression based on currently selected tiles is incorrect. Specifically, this error occurred after deselecting an operator tile and subsequently selecting a number tile, in which case the default operator (addition in most circumstances) does not appear in the math expression preceding the number of the tile selected.

notes.title: Patch 3.1.5 - Fix For Misplaced Incremented Cards-Earned Animation
notes.content: This patch fixes the positioning of animation that shows adjacent to cards earned stat in top left of screen to signal that the cards earned stat has been incremented after a card has been earned. Previously, this animation appeared farther toward the middle screen, instead of adjacent to the cards earned stat.

notes.title: Patch 2.1.6 - Cloud Support Enabled & Hotfix for User Data Not Saving
notes.content:
This update includes Steam Cloud implementation, a hotfix for user data not saving between sessions, and minor bug fixes and improvements as noted below. 

Minor Bug Fixes & Improvements:

 Fixed positioning of swipe bonus animation so it appears near game score stat instead of on the right side of the screen.
 Increased size of card artwork for Add Tiles action card
